LESSON: IDDAH

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Iddah
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Iddah, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: Why is Iddah acceptable in Islam?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search for information on the iddah for a divorcee and a widow in Islam and share in class,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Iddah together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of decision-making is enhanced as learners discuss the importance

of iddah.

• Learning to learn: the skill of working collaboratively enhanced as learners discuss the importance of iddah in

groups and make a class presentation.

• Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication enhanced as learners discuss the importance of observing Iddah in

groups and make a class presentation.

Values:
● Social Justice is enhanced as learners describe the rationale for iddah

● Respect is enhanced as learners describe the rationale for iddah in groups and present in class

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Gender education is enhanced as learners discuss the importance of iddah
